features.name: Postman collections
features.usage: Separated the 41 data-driven FR-04 cases from three dedicated stateful multi-request flows while retaining canonical case IDs in request/test execution.

features.name: Postman environment and environment variables
features.usage: Stored the base URL, student ID, credentials, tokens, and baseline state used by the FR-04 collections and Newman runs.

features.name: Collection pre-request scripts
features.usage: Injected X-Student-Id: 23127179 into every collection request and constructed case-specific request bodies and authentication modes.

features.name: Postman test scripts and assertions
features.usage: Performed authenticated read-back, persistence, protected-field, cleanup, and state-transition assertions without inventing undocumented response status/schema requirements.

features.name: Data-driven Newman iterations
features.usage: Executed 41 canonical FR-04 input-partition cases from an external JSON data file, with one canonical case ID per iteration.

features.name: pm.sendRequest helper requests
features.usage: Issued authenticated read-back and cleanup requests from test scripts to verify persisted state independently of the selected PUT response.

features.name: Newman CLI with JSON and HTML reporters
features.usage: Ran the committed collections with the locked Newman dependency and captured CLI output, raw JSON, HTML, command arguments, hashes, timestamps, and hostnames.

features.name: Postman Console
features.usage: Used the Postman Desktop Console to verify a real request carried X-Student-Id: 23127179.
